# Check — M0-a-04, insertion steps 1–2: closing check of the kernel's consolidation round R2 (lane check/M0-a-04-consolidate-close-1, 2026-10-11)

**Verdict: PASS.** Every finding of the round (I-1 – I-6, W-3, C-insert-1/2 with T-step1-2, NO-SHIFT) is fixed against its
oracle with this checker's own evidence; no new finding is a blocker. The round changes no behaviour: a seeded
differential probe of the pre-round sources against the consolidated ones is byte-identical over seven families and
four unit predicates, in both the `kernel` and `kernel-tiny` projects; the pre-round test folder runs green on the
consolidated sources; every exported name of `insert/index.ts` and the barrel is unchanged; 33 of 33 targeted mutants
are red, each of the plan's named oracle mutants by its named case. Every gate exits 0 and the record verifies.
Refusal counts are unchanged (re-measured, below). Three notes rows (N-c2-1 – N-c2-3) go to `checks/M0-a-04-notes.md`.

Seat: closing checker, independent of the author (the author's self-check, CHECKPOINT lines and result notes were not
read before this checker's probes and mutants were planned and run; the notes file's R2 map was read afterwards and
judged, not used as evidence). Machine: `linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz:4cpu:16gib` (J198 id matches),
Node v24.12.0, 1 worker (`tools/test_budget.py` printed 1 before each run; mutant budget 1). No timing is taken or
gated on. No git command was run.
